title: C6 follow-up: stamp only top-level starts, pre-stamp Claude spawns
head: 94dd73c440812d2f609b5e39a753f0e736c5fc57
brief: Follow-up to #275 (display only). _stamp_child stamps from the running turn only for a lifecycle 'started' record with no parent; a grandchild of an unseen parent, a first subagent_event or a non-started lifecycle record gets no stamp. A new daemon._spawned pre-stamps cl:<call id> from a Claude TOOL_STARTED named Agent/Task in the orchestrator's own turn stream. The seen-sid set no longer evicts. Docs now show C6 as live.
focus: correctness, including under concurrency and across the ordering of events
handling of untrusted input, and safety-boundary changes
test coverage of the new behaviour: would the tests fail without the change?
claims in the description against the evidence in the diff and tests

ground_truth.mechanism: _spawned is called under the daemon lock in _record without an exception guard, so a raise would cost the event's log and bus record
the turn-changed guard on the _spawned call is untested (mutant dropping it survives) and cannot trip on today's paths
